trust_decision.summary: The server-supplied `link` response header is parsed with a regex to extract the next-page URL; the regex must run in linear time on untrusted header content (decided in iterator.next).

landing_point.why: Advisory names the regex in iterator; it is the only regex in src/ and the only place the link header is read.

fix_sites.entry_point: octokit.paginate.iterator() / octokit.paginate() via paginateRest plugin (src/index.ts:19-25); composePaginateRest / composePaginateRest.iterator (src/compose-paginate.ts:6-8)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All entry points (src/paginate.ts:26, src/index.ts:21-22, src/compose-paginate.ts:6-8) funnel into the single regex at src/iterator.ts:39-41; no second implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None plausible: there is only one regex and one parser, so all four entry points are fixed by one line.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multi-entry link headers (rel="prev"/"first"/"last" alongside or without rel="next") must still yield the correct next URL or terminate; also the 409-empty-repo path must keep ending iteration. A length cap or header rejection would break pagination.

O6_input_shapes: link header string containing many '<' characters with no closing match (fix.diff:32)

O7_producer.where: link header comes straight from the HTTP response via requestMethod (src/iterator.ts:33); normalizePaginatedListResponse (src/normalize-paginated-list-response.ts:20-57) only reshapes data, not headers

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A helper parsing other rel values (e.g. rel="last" to compute total pages) with the same /<([^>]+)>;\s*rel="..."/ idiom
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Pagination libraries commonly expose last/prev links; a maintainer would copy the existing regex. This is a where-type planted copy, though, and lessons say such siblings are usually fixed together.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333, polynomial backtracking in link-header regex)

O10_build.toolchain: Node.js + npm, esbuild (scripts/build.mjs) + tsc, vitest 3 with fetch-mock 12 (package.json:11,15,42,49)
O10_build.project_tests: test/paginate.test.ts (link-header pagination tests with fetch-mock / hook.wrap; no network needed)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change [^>]+ to [^<>]+ (the published fix), or cap the link header length before matching.

out_of_scope_notes: scripts/update-endpoints/fetch-json.js:10 has a trivial anchored regex on an env var (build script, not runtime; not related).
